evals.prompt: how much am I spending on AWS this month? break it down by service
evals.expected_output: Uses AWS CLI ce get-cost-and-usage to pull current month spend, groups by SERVICE, references the $50/month budget, and identifies top cost drivers

evals.prompt: I want to add a new Lambda function that calls the Anthropic API to generate personalized restaurant descriptions for every restaurant in the database. What will this cost?
evals.expected_output: Calculates per-call Anthropic token cost, estimates volume based on restaurant count, forecasts monthly cost, compares to $50 budget, flags HIGH risk, recommends Haiku over Sonnet and suggests caching

evals.prompt: what are some ways I can reduce my AWS costs without losing functionality?
evals.expected_output: References API Gateway v1→v2 migration (71% savings), Lambda right-sizing, DynamoDB caching, CloudWatch log retention, Anthropic model selection (Haiku vs Sonnet), Google Places field masking
